title: An adjoint pair with an exact left adjoint transfers enough injectives
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file homology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that if an additive functor has a right adjoint which preserves injective maps, the source category has enough injectives and the right adjoint kills no nonzero object, then the target category has enough injectives (statement lines 7545-7558). The proof is a complete argument: for an arbitrary object of the target one chooses an injection of its image into an injective object of the source, which exists by hypothesis, and the cited lemma together with the assumptions identifies the adjoint transpose as an injection of that object into an injective object (proof lines 7560-7566). The non-formal content is the use of the adjunction to transport the embedding. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
